name: kanso
title: Kanso
description: Capture notes and tasks into Kanso, and find your notes, from Raycast.
author: ngonidzashe_mangudya

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: Kanso
commands.description: Save a note to Kanso. The first line is the title.

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: Kanso
commands.description: Add a task with a date and repeat, like film review fri 3pm every week.

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Kanso
commands.description: Search your notes. Enter opens the note in Kanso.

commands.name: open-note
commands.title: Open Note
commands.subtitle: Kanso
commands.description: Recently updated notes. Enter opens one in Kanso.

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect to Kanso
commands.subtitle: Kanso
commands.description: Pair Raycast with Kanso, or paste a key by hand.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Local API Port
preferences.description: The port under Kanso > Settings > Local API.

preferences.name: key
preferences.title: Key (Optional)
preferences.description: A kcl_ key made by hand under Kanso > Settings > Local API > API keys. It wins over a paired key.
